Verification summaries retain both stdout and stderr from one execution. Regressions cover stderr identities with nonempty stdout, original raw framing, command/subject/digest bindings, stdout-only and mixed streams, and no rerun.

Projection preserves identity order, caps nodes at 32, and reports truncation truthfully. Regressions cover 0, 1, 32, 33 and 70 entries; text-derived details retain unknown population, completeness, stability and phase facts.

Later unclosed or malformed sections invalidate earlier spoof identities. Explicit final-summary uncertainty and 16 MiB scan-exhaustion states remain distinct, with regressions for malformed, unsupported, absent, ERROR-only, CRLF and mixed-header sources.

Portable FAILURE, Brain Sync and terminal-attention projections retain allowlisted identities, fixed diagnostic categories and owner/digest bindings while withholding parameters and raw diagnostics. Existing regressions cover forged and moved sources.

Historical public V1/V2 and private decoder paths, owner gating, once-only verification and production implementation remain intact. The fixture now accepts show and cat-file while preserving failure.json and rejection assertions. All six focused contamination cases passed locally; the fixture-only correction is committed and the working tree is clean.
